Paired branch for phase 7 of the default-workspace-template's chat-agent split, which drops the chat app's `/api/agents/...` aliases: the harness-arms spec (`specs/minds-eval-harbor/harness_arms.md`) names the driver's model choice as `POST /api/chats/<chat_id>/model`, the route the bridge now posts to. Its Background section keeps the spellings that were real at the template commit it pins.
